findings.title: Lint negation matching treats a bare "not" anywhere in the span's sentence as negating
findings.action: No change: the miss direction is fail-closed (a real invocation stops counting, so the capture lints FAIL loudly); a false pass is impossible.
findings.disposition_rationale: Stricter-only: the whole-sentence window can only stop a real invocation counting, which fails the capture lints loudly; it can never fabricate a driver.
